description: This file defines the `CleanUpInstallAPI` class in the `OrangeHRM\Validator` namespace, which is a REST API controller for cleaning up the installation process in the OrangeHRM system. It inherits from `AbstractInstallerRestController` and implements the `handlePost` method to perform database cleanup or reset based on the installation type.

classes.name: CleanUpInstallAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class responsible for cleaning up or resetting the installation process depending on the database type.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to trigger cleanup actions such as dropping the database or cleaning up after a failed installation.
